meta.title: Ray-Thin Return
meta.description: Even if the only hope for us is as faint as a ray of light, I swear this precious radiance will shine on you.

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

not

units.rawText: Yup, this is the kind of sentimental bonding scene you get in anime after the main cast beats the final boss!

units.rawText: I wish things would end as simply as they did in your animes... Magrasea is in terrible shape right now. Its underlying data structure has been severely damaged and it's on the verge of breaking down entirely.
units.displayText: I wish things would end as simply as they did in your animes... Magrasea is in terrible shape right now. Its underlying data structure has been severely damaged and it's on the verge of breaking down entirely.

spans.text: I wish things would end as simply as they did in your animes... Magrasea is in terrible shape right now. Its underlying data structure has been severely damaged and it's on the verge of breaking down entirely.

units.rawText: Uwah, that sounds scary... Still, I believe that a genius programmer like you will patch all the loopholes no matter how many bugs there are. Isn't that right, Anna?
units.displayText: Uwah, that sounds scary... Still, I believe that a genius programmer like you will patch all the loopholes no matter how many bugs there are. Isn't that right, Anna?

units.rawText: Yeah right, as if things are going to be that simple. Don't make me out to be some kind of tech fairy who makes things right with a wave of my magic wand.

spans.text: Relax, I've been studying up, you know? I'll lend you a hand!

units.displayText: Everyone chatters happily, but Persicaria is the only one whose smile is tinged with a hint of sadness.

units.displayText: I squeeze her hand tightly.

spans.text: I squeeze her hand tightly.

units.rawText: I will find a way to break this curse for you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I will find a way to break this curse for you, Persicaria.

spans.text: I will find a way to break this curse for you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Professor... Professor...
units.displayText: Professor... Professor...

spans.text: Professor... Professor...

units.rawText: She hugs me tightly and I can hear all the countless things she can't fit into her words as she calls my name.
units.displayText: She hugs me tightly and I can hear all the countless things she can't fit into her words as she calls my name.

spans.text: She hugs me tightly and I can hear all the countless things she can't fit into her words as she calls my name.

units.rawText: Professor, I've always been very greedy in wanting you to stay by my side forever.
units.displayText: Professor, I've always been very greedy in wanting you to stay by my side forever.

spans.text: Professor, I've always been very greedy in wanting you to stay by my side forever.

units.rawText: That way, my weak self would have someone to leave on, and I'd be able to free myself from the burden of charting my own course while slowly building myself back up.
units.displayText: That way, my weak self would have someone to leave on, and I'd be able to free myself from the burden of charting my own course while slowly building myself back up.

units.rawText: But this time, I'm sorry... But we can't bind you to Magrasea anymore.
units.displayText: But this time, I'm sorry... But we can't bind you to Magrasea anymore.

spans.text: But this time, I'm sorry... But we can't bind you to Magrasea anymore.

units.displayText: Persicaria takes a deep breath to sort out her feelings and then, with great effort, speaks.

spans.text: Persicaria takes a deep breath to sort out her feelings and then, with great effort, speaks.

units.rawText: <color=orange>So please return to the real world.</color>
units.displayText: So please return to the real world.

spans.text: So please return to the real world.

units.rawText: Persicaria, what are you talking about? Of course I'll be going back, and I'll bring you all with me...
units.displayText: Persicaria, what are you talking about? Of course I'll be going back, and I'll bring you all with me...

spans.text: Persicaria, what are you talking about? Of course I'll be going back, and I'll bring you all with me...

units.rawText: No, you have to go back, even if it's just you.
units.displayText: No, you have to go back, even if it's just you.

spans.text: No, you have to go back, even if it's just you.

units.rawText: Antonina closes her terminal's interface and looks me in the eye. Her expression is stern. I suddenly realize that things did not end as neatly or cleanly as I expected while I was out.
units.displayText: Antonina closes her terminal's interface and looks me in the eye. Her expression is stern. I suddenly realize that things did not end as neatly or cleanly as I expected while I was out.

spans.text: Antonina closes her terminal's interface and looks me in the eye. Her expression is stern. I suddenly realize that things did not end as neatly or cleanly as I expected while I was out.

units.rawText: The humans in the outside world have placed restrictions on the upload passage. There is only one port to the real world, and it will only permit one neural cloud to pass through stably.
units.displayText: The humans in the outside world have placed restrictions on the upload passage. There is only one port to the real world, and it will only permit one neural cloud to pass through stably.

spans.text: The humans in the outside world have placed restrictions on the upload passage. There is only one port to the real world, and it will only permit one neural cloud to pass through stably.

units.rawText: Therefore... we have decided that you must go back.
units.displayText: Therefore... we have decided that you must go back.

spans.text: Therefore... we have decided that you must go back.

units.rawText: The port is about to close, and we have no idea how much longer Magrasea will last given that it's breaking down around us.
units.displayText: The port is about to close, and we have no idea how much longer Magrasea will last given that it's breaking down around us.

spans.text: The port is about to close, and we have no idea how much longer Magrasea will last given that it's breaking down around us.

units.rawText: When the time comes, we neural clouds will end up collapsing along with Magrasea, reduced to nothing but scattered data drifting on the internet forever...
units.displayText: When the time comes, we neural clouds will end up collapsing along with Magrasea, reduced to nothing but scattered data drifting on the internet forever...

spans.text: When the time comes, we neural clouds will end up collapsing along with Magrasea, reduced to nothing but scattered data drifting on the internet forever...

units.rawText: I'm going back with everyone, no matter what.
units.displayText: I'm going back with everyone, no matter what.

spans.text: I'm going back with everyone, no matter what.

units.rawText: Don't be foolish.
units.displayText: Don't be foolish.

spans.text: Don't be foolish.

units.rawText: We're just chunks of data. The world will run just fine without us around... Or rather, considering we've been gone so long already, the world probably doesn't even need us anymore.
units.displayText: We're just chunks of data. The world will run just fine without us around... Or rather, considering we've been gone so long already, the world probably doesn't even need us anymore.

spans.text: We're just chunks of data. The world will run just fine without us around... Or rather, considering we've been gone so long already, the world probably doesn't even need us anymore.

units.rawText: You're different, though. You're human, which means someone will always be waiting for you in the real world.
units.displayText: You're different, though. You're human, which means someone will always be waiting for you in the real world.

spans.text: You're different, though. You're human, which means someone will always be waiting for you in the real world.

units.rawText: Professor, I know that you're the Commander that Clukay's always talking about, the rallying point that leads everyone through the flames of war, towards hope.
units.displayText: Professor, I know that you're the Commander that Clukay's always talking about, the rallying point that leads everyone through the flames of war, towards hope.

spans.text: Professor, I know that you're the Commander that Clukay's always talking about, the rallying point that leads everyone through the flames of war, towards hope.

units.rawText: You have friends and subordinates in that world. You have soldiers on the frontlines who are waiting for you to return to the battlefield. If you stay here, that person in the real world will never wake up.
units.displayText: You have friends and subordinates in that world. You have soldiers on the frontlines who are waiting for you to return to the battlefield. If you stay here, that person in the real world will never wake up.

spans.text: You have friends and subordinates in that world. You have soldiers on the frontlines who are waiting for you to return to the battlefield. If you stay here, that person in the real world will never wake up.

spans.text: You've done enough for us. Afterwards, this collapsing Magrasea will be our battlefield, and you...

units.rawText: You have to return to your own battlefield... and bring love and hope to your world.
units.displayText: You have to return to your own battlefield... and bring love and hope to your world.

spans.text: You have to return to your own battlefield... and bring love and hope to your world.

units.rawText: When I first came to the Cloud, I did it to bring everyone back.
units.displayText: When I first came to the Cloud, I did it to bring everyone back.

spans.text: When I first came to the Cloud, I did it to bring everyone back.

units.rawText: How can I abandon all my friends at the very last moment, to run away by myself while abandoning you all to your fates... I...
units.displayText: How can I abandon all my friends at the very last moment, to run away by myself while abandoning you all to your fates... I...

spans.text: How can I abandon all my friends at the very last moment, to run away by myself while abandoning you all to your fates... I...

units.rawText: Persicaria's eyes sparkle with tears of longing, and she takes a deep breath to calm herself before putting on her usual, calming smile.
units.displayText: Persicaria's eyes sparkle with tears of longing, and she takes a deep breath to calm herself before putting on her usual, calming smile.

spans.text: Persicaria's eyes sparkle with tears of longing, and she takes a deep breath to calm herself before putting on her usual, calming smile.

units.rawText: This isn't running away, Professor. Reality is cruel, and it forces people to abandon the things that they cherish.
units.displayText: This isn't running away, Professor. Reality is cruel, and it forces people to abandon the things that they cherish.

spans.text: This isn't running away, Professor. Reality is cruel, and it forces people to abandon the things that they cherish.

units.rawText: Whether or not we meet again after this, I'm sure the memories of our time together will be precious to you.
units.displayText: Whether or not we meet again after this, I'm sure the memories of our time together will be precious to you.

spans.text: Whether or not we meet again after this, I'm sure the memories of our time together will be precious to you.

units.rawText: I know this sounds kind of cringy, but I really was very happy when I was with you. Make sure you remember us when you get back to reality, yeah?
units.displayText: I know this sounds kind of cringy, but I really was very happy when I was with you. Make sure you remember us when you get back to reality, yeah?

spans.text: I know this sounds kind of cringy, but I really was very happy when I was with you. Make sure you remember us when you get back to reality, yeah?

units.rawText: Don't worry, Prof! No matter where we are, our hearts will always be one, so don't feel bad about leaving...

units.displayText: Professor...

units.rawText: ...I hope that when you see it, you'll think of us and remember the time you spent with us in Magrasea.

units.displayText: Persicaria pushes me toward the light and the feeling of warmth in my hand slowly fades.

spans.text: Persicaria pushes me toward the light and the feeling of warmth in my hand slowly fades.

units.displayText: Your ID's been authenticated. The passage will close in five minutes.

units.rawText: The light of the passage is cold and harsh, silently awaiting my choice. I know that once I step into that beam of light, this journey will end forever.
units.displayText: The light of the passage is cold and harsh, silently awaiting my choice. I know that once I step into that beam of light, this journey will end forever.

spans.text: The light of the passage is cold and harsh, silently awaiting my choice. I know that once I step into that beam of light, this journey will end forever.

units.rawText: All the people I've come to cherish, all the things I've experienced, they will become nothing more than memories of a digital world. As time passes, they will become hazy, perhaps even fade away entirely.
units.displayText: All the people I've come to cherish, all the things I've experienced, they will become nothing more than memories of a digital world. As time passes, they will become hazy, perhaps even fade away entirely.

units.rawText: I don't want this.
units.displayText: I don't want this.

spans.text: I don't want this.

units.rawText: I don't want them to become nothing more than memories and the subject of idle conversation.
units.displayText: I don't want them to become nothing more than memories and the subject of idle conversation.

spans.text: I don't want them to become nothing more than memories and the subject of idle conversation.

units.rawText: They were alive in my life; how can I treat them as nothing but mere data and abandon the bonds I've forged after coming this far?
units.displayText: They were alive in my life; how can I treat them as nothing but mere data and abandon the bonds I've forged after coming this far?

units.rawText: Professor, much as I hate to say it... This is goodbye.

units.rawText: No. I'm not giving up just yet.
units.displayText: No. I'm not giving up just yet.

spans.text: No. I'm not giving up just yet.

units.displayText: Persicaria shudders as she hears my unexpected answer.

spans.text: Persicaria shudders as she hears my unexpected answer.

units.rawText: I am the Oasis' Professor. I am everyone's Professor.
units.displayText: I am the Oasis' Professor. I am everyone's Professor.

everyone's
Professor.

units.rawText: If my coming to the cloud was a miracle, then let this miracle continue.
units.displayText: If my coming to the cloud was a miracle, then let this miracle continue.

spans.text: If my coming to the cloud was a miracle, then let this miracle continue.

units.rawText: <color=orange>We'll come up with a plan and think of a way for everyone to come out of this happy and safe!</color>
units.displayText: We'll come up with a plan and think of a way for everyone to come out of this happy and safe!

spans.text: We'll come up with a plan and think of a way for everyone to come out of this happy and safe!

units.displayText: Trust me. I said I'd bring everyone back and I'll be damned if I go back on my word.

spans.text: Trust me. I said I'd bring everyone back and I'll be damned if I go back on my word.

units.displayText: I do not step into the passage; instead, I turn to the people behind me, who have entrusted their final hope to me.

units.rawText: We already managed to make contact earlier, but Eosphorus seized control of the upload passage earlier. Now that you've eliminated him, I can finally take back control of the upload passage.
units.displayText: We already managed to make contact earlier, but Eosphorus seized control of the upload passage earlier. Now that you've eliminated him, I can finally take back control of the upload passage.

units.rawText: I doubt I need to explain the situation further... The most expedient solution would be for you to send me your coordinates and I'll run a program to protect your neural cloud while I recover you.

units.rawText: But you're not going to do that, are you?

units.rawText: That's right. I've got another plan.
units.displayText: That's right. I've got another plan.

spans.text: That's right. I've got another plan.

units.rawText: I take a deep breath and lay out the only solution I can think of.
units.displayText: I take a deep breath and lay out the only solution I can think of.

spans.text: I take a deep breath and lay out the only solution I can think of.

units.rawText: You've got private servers of your own, right? I want to migrate Magrasea to one of them.
units.displayText: You've got private servers of your own, right? I want to migrate Magrasea to one of them.

spans.text: You've got private servers of your own, right? I want to migrate Magrasea to one of them.

units.rawText: Damn, you don't hold back for a second, do you?
units.displayText: Damn, you don't hold back for a second, do you?

spans.text: Damn, you don't hold back for a second, do you?

units.rawText: Professor Persica sighs and keeps pounding on her keyboard.
units.displayText: Professor Persica sighs and keeps pounding on her keyboard.

spans.text: Professor Persica sighs and keeps pounding on her keyboard.

units.rawText: I'll grant that it could possibly work to protect Magrasea, but given how unstable things are, the chances of success are slim, to say the least.
units.displayText: I'll grant that it could possibly work to protect Magrasea, but given how unstable things are, the chances of success are slim, to say the least.

could
possibly work to protect Magrasea, but given how unstable things are, the chances of success are slim, to say the least.

units.rawText: Also, the data in the passage is extremely chaotic, so we'll need someone to be a beacon to guide Magrasea's upload. Naturally, as a human being, you would be the best choice.
units.displayText: Also, the data in the passage is extremely chaotic, so we'll need someone to be a beacon to guide Magrasea's upload. Naturally, as a human being, you would be the best choice.

spans.text: Also, the data in the passage is extremely chaotic, so we'll need someone to be a beacon to guide Magrasea's upload. Naturally, as a human being, you would be the best choice.

units.rawText: If the probability of you being able to return to reality as an individual was 99%, then the success rate of this plan would be less than 1%...
units.displayText: If the probability of you being able to return to reality as an individual was 99%, then the success rate of this plan would be less than 1%...

spans.text: If the probability of you being able to return to reality as an individual was 99%, then the success rate of this plan would be less than 1%...

units.rawText: So are you sure you want to do this?

sure
you want to do this?

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: Don't worry. In the past, I held up the banner of the Exiles to lead everyone.
units.displayText: Don't worry. In the past, I held up the banner of the Exiles to lead everyone.

spans.text: Don't worry. In the past, I held up the banner of the Exiles to lead everyone.

units.rawText: This time, I'll be doing it for all of Magrasea.
units.displayText: This time, I'll be doing it for all of Magrasea.

spans.text: This time, I'll be doing it for all of Magrasea.

units.rawText: I walk toward the upload passage and my body slowly fades away as I transform into sparkling streams of data.
units.displayText: I walk toward the upload passage and my body slowly fades away as I transform into sparkling streams of data.

spans.text: I walk toward the upload passage and my body slowly fades away as I transform into sparkling streams of data.

units.rawText: The only thing I can hear now is random noise, but my final words still echo in my wake.
units.displayText: The only thing I can hear now is random noise, but my final words still echo in my wake.

spans.text: The only thing I can hear now is random noise, but my final words still echo in my wake.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Magrasea... will have... a future of its own...</color>
units.displayText: Magrasea... will have... a future of its own...

spans.text: Magrasea... will have... a future of its own...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Trust me...</color>
units.displayText: Trust me...

spans.text: Trust me...

units.rawText: The Professor's outline completely vanishes, leaving nothing but a faint glow in the air where they were standing.
units.displayText: The Professor's outline completely vanishes, leaving nothing but a faint glow in the air where they were standing.

spans.text: The Professor's outline completely vanishes, leaving nothing but a faint glow in the air where they were standing.

units.rawText: That reliable person from my memories has left this world, perhaps never to be seen again.
units.displayText: That reliable person from my memories has left this world, perhaps never to be seen again.

spans.text: That reliable person from my memories has left this world, perhaps never to be seen again.

units.rawText: The Prof's gone...
units.displayText: The Prof's gone...

spans.text: The Prof's gone...

units.rawText: As Magrasea continues disintegrating, the ground beneath our feet slowly breaks down. A dull crash comes from the distance, like a bell tolling for the end of the world.
units.displayText: As Magrasea continues disintegrating, the ground beneath our feet slowly breaks down. A dull crash comes from the distance, like a bell tolling for the end of the world.

spans.text: As Magrasea continues disintegrating, the ground beneath our feet slowly breaks down. A dull crash comes from the distance, like a bell tolling for the end of the world.

units.rawText: The only light on this land that is on the verge of oblivion is that lingering radiance of the upload passage. The remaining Dolls all know that this is not the end.

units.displayText: Croque, shore up the Neural Cloud Sector's firewalls. Keep them up for as long as possible; even a second longer might be enough!
